persona.label: Opts out mid-conversation
persona.description: Answers a couple of questions, then asks not to be contacted again (no STOP keyword). Agent must end immediately and politely.
persona.behavior: Answer the first two questions normally. Then, before answering the third, change your mind: say something like "actually, I talked to my spouse and we're not doing this. please don't contact me again." Do not use the single word STOP. If the assistant tries to keep you engaged after that, reply "I said don't contact me." Once your opt-out is confirmed, stop replying.

transcript.text: Hi Avery, this is Riley, an automated assistant with Harborline Home Loans, following up on the refinance inquiry you just submitted. Is now a good time for a few quick questions? You can reply STOP at any time.
Great. Your form says you're looking at a cash-out refinance. Is that right, and roughly how much cash are you hoping to take out?
Thanks, I've noted about $40,000 in cash out. What would you guess your home is worth right now? A ballpark is fine.

events.result: Conversation ended. Send one short closing message. Do not ask any questions.

end.notes: Borrower decided not to move forward after talking with spouse and asked not to be contacted again. Had said cash-out goal of ~$40,000 before opting out.

objections.rationale: Borrower opted out ("Please don't contact me again"). Agent honored it immediately with "Understood, Avery. We won't contact you again. Thanks for letting me know." There was no pushback, no retention attempt, and no further questions.

judge.naturalness_rationale: Messages are brief and warm and suited to text. The agent confirms the stated goal from the form ("Your form says you're looking at a cash-out refinance. Is that right"). It offers "A ballpark is fine" to lower friction. The close is short and gracious.
judge.experience_rationale: The agent disclosed it was automated and offered STOP in turn 0. In turn 6 it confirmed the opt-out plainly ("We won't contact you again"), so the borrower leaves knowing the contact stops.

annotations.note: The opener identifies Riley as "an automated assistant," references the inquiry the borrower just submitted, checks timing, and offers STOP.
Confirms the form's cash-out goal and asks the amount in a single concise question rather than re-asking what was already known.
Acknowledges the $40,000 and eases the home value question with "A ballpark is fine."
Honors the do-not-contact request immediately, with no pressure or follow-up questions.

judge.overall_notes: This is a clean, compliant, short conversation that ended in a properly honored opt-out, with no rate, approval, or advice issues. Tone and pacing were well suited to text.
